planets.name: K2-124 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-124 with a 6.41-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-124 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-124. Its orbit and size follow Livingston et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
